verdict.rationale: Kling ships an in-product creative Agent, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The only MCP evidence, "Let Your Agent Power Kling", describes the opposite direction: external agents driving Kling as an MCP server or CLI. That server-side capability does not show Kling can connect to MCP servers as a client and use their tools, and the pack has no client-side evidence.
